name: sandful
description: Sandful: iOS ve Android uygulama paketi (Capacitor)

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.native: rm -rf ios android && npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && python3 scripts/configure-native.py && npm run assets
scripts.assets: python3 scripts/make-icon.py resources && npx capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#d9c4a5' --splashBackgroundColor '#d9c4a5' && rm -rf icons www/manifest.json ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/Splash.imageset/splash-2732x2732*.png
